_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_AnimateTT: Keeps your character's idle animation playing. Off, they hold still.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_AutoAdjustTT: Places and sizes the item card and 3D model to suit your screen's shape, from 16:9 to 32:9.\n[Off by default on non-stock layouts.]
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_BenchLabelXTT: Moves the crafting bench description left or right.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_CameraControlsTT: Move the camera with the mouse and controller. Off, only the sliders under Position move it. Turning your character works either way.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_EnableTT: Toggles Show Player In Inventory ON and OFF.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_FrameShiftTT: Moves your character left or right, adjusting their framing in the menu.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_HideApparelPreviewItemsTT: Hides the item card and 3D model while a piece is previewed on your character with Apparel Preview, so they don't cover it.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_HideObstructionsTT: Hides things and people standing between the camera and your character while they're shown, and brings them back after.\n[A trade-off: No obstructions, but other minor visual issues.]
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_ItemCardTT: Moves and sizes the selected item's card in every item menu. Changes show as you slide, with a menu open underneath.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_ItemPreviewTT: Moves and sizes the selected item's 3D model in every item menu. Changes show as you slide, with a menu open underneath.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_RememberCameraTT: Opens the menu with the camera where you left it last time. Off, it starts from the default view each time.\n[In the inventory and magic menus, standing still on foot.]
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_RememberFacingTT: Also keeps which way you turned your character, so they face the camera the same way next time, rather than as they stand or as Turn Character turns them.\n[Only with Remember Camera.]
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_ResetCameraTT: Puts the camera back where it starts. Works while a menu showing your character is open.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_SlidersClosed: The position sliders work while a menu showing your character is open.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_SneakVignetteTT: Darkens the edges of the menu while you're sneaking unseen, and clears once someone notices you.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_StartFovTT: The field of view menus open at. Changing it with the camera controls lasts until the menu closes, unless Remember Camera keeps it.
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_TurnCharacterTT: Your character turns to face the camera where it is. Off, the camera comes round to face your character instead, so they stay as they are.\n[In the inventory and magic menus, on foot.]
line:menu_translation/show-player-in-inv.$SPII_UpperBodyTT: Frames your character from the chest up, rather than head to toe.
